items.title: Saba Capital raises Pantheon International stake to 15%
items.summary: US activist investor Saba Capital Management has increased its holding in the FTSE 250 investment trust Pantheon International from 12% to 15% over a four-week period.

items.title: Which? extends LifeSearch partnership with self-service life insurance platform
items.summary: The consumer group has launched a co-branded digital journey with LifeSearch, generating commission to fund its not-for-profit work.

items.title: HSBC Asset Management rates 98% of funds as delivering investor value
items.summary: The asset manager's latest Assessment of Value report identifies only one fund rated amber for moderate value in the year to June 2026.

items.title: UKGI consultant urges brokers to assess AI accountability under FCA guidelines
items.summary: Insurance brokers must clarify artificial intelligence usage, risks and oversight to align with Financial Conduct Authority expectations.

items.title: ICA logs 4,670 claims from severe storms across Queensland and New South Wales
items.summary: Insurers have received thousands of claims following severe storms and supercell thunderstorms affecting parts of Australia.

items.title: Global security agencies highlight growing industrial espionage risks for technology firms
items.summary: Intelligence services report an intensification of state-backed espionage targeting artificial intelligence and advanced technology sectors.
